'''Patient Zero''', also known as the '''Rakghoul Progenitor''', was the first [[Rakghoul]] created by [[Karness Muur]]. He was held in stasis in the [[Arcanum]] by [[Darth Acina]] until he was set free by [[Tagriss]], a rogue [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] in service to the [[Dread Masters]].<ref name="Arcanum" />

==History==
An unnamed [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]], "Patient Zero" was born sometime during the [[Golden Age of the Sith]]. Karness Muur, one of the first [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lords of the Sith]], used [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] to engineer the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|Rakghoul plague]], a highly contagious infection intended to be used to create an army of mindless beasts to rule [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. This unnamed humanoid became the first person to be infected by Muur's creation, by having the [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith magic]] from the [[Muur Talisman]] used on him.<ref name="KotORVector">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: Vector]]''</ref>

Thousands of years later, [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Acina, a newly made [[Dark Council]] member, held him in stasis in the Arcanum, a space station used to hold dangerous [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]]. However, Lord Tagriss raided the station by order of the Dread Masters and set Patient Zero free.<ref name="Arcanum" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Patient Zero is a level 53 champion enemy NPC encountered in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', added in patch 2.0.0. He appears during the seeker droid questline and is classified as "Rakghoul Progenitor."<ref name="Arcanum" />
